hazards.evidence: Frequently used plates and bowls are stored in a high wall cabinet, requiring overhead reaching.
A dining chair blocks and narrows the central kitchen walking path needed for walker use.
The kitchen and adjoining walking areas are dimly lit with deep shadows.
A pet bed and feeding bowl sit on the floor beside the main route into the kitchen and could catch a walker or foot.
